purpose: Exact identity allowlist for Training Guide character, upgradeable combat-skill, and equipped-weapon OCR. It contains no planning or orchestration logic.

matching.guideRowCoverage: The guide can display any 1-3 configured combat skills; absence from a page is not identity evidence.
matching.traveler: 空 and 荧 intentionally retain every elemental talent variant; callers must resolve the live element from current evidence and must not auto-select a variant.
matching.weapons: Each canonical name maps to source candidates because the pinned data contains three distinct IDs named 「一心传」名刀; a name match validates spelling but does not resolve that duplicate identity.
matching.displayLabels: canonicalName preserves the pinned raw combat skill name. No prefix stripping, punctuation rewriting, aliasing, or fuzzy matching is defined. observedGuideSamples covers only names actually seen in saved guide evidence.
